stem.text: A cell that has internal resistance is connected to a switch S and a variable resistor. A voltmeter is connected between the terminals of the cell, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with a voltmeter labelled V connected across a cell, a switch labelled S, and a variable resistor, with junction dots at the cell terminals.

stem.text: When switch S is open, the voltmeter reads $1.5\,\text{V}$. The switch is then closed and the variable resistor is adjusted to have a resistance of $4.0\,\Omega$. The voltmeter now reads $0.75\,\text{V}$.
What is the internal resistance of the cell?
